marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Something is growing in the murky waters of Grant lake. A genetic engineer at the neighboring Gereco Corporation has conducted a series a series of experiment on growing giant pre-historic crocodiles. But one of the experiments has gotten out of control. The only survivor from the age of dinasours erupts from the depth of Grant Lake raveneous for prey. The nightmare comes to life as Dinocroc terrorizes the resident at the once peaceful community. Not even the best of the best can stop this feeding frenzy!
